en.headline: Man arrested after alleged tile assault in Sheung Shui
en.dek: A 53-year-old man was detained on suspicion of wounding after police said he used a tile to strike a 48-year-old man late Wednesday night in Sheung Shui.
body: Police arrested a 53-year-old man on suspicion of wounding after he allegedly used a tile to attack a 48-year-old man in Sheung Shui late on Wednesday.

Officers received a report of a fight at the junction of New Ching Road and San Cheung Street around 11pm. Initial investigations indicated that the 53-year-old man, surnamed Chan, struck the 48-year-old man, surnamed Wu, with a tile. Chan was arrested and is being held for further enquiries. The case has been passed to the Tai Po District Crime Squad.

Wu sustained injuries to his face and mouth and was taken to North District Hospital in a conscious state. Chan was also taken to the same hospital for examination. Police said Chan smelled of alcohol and the two men did not know each other. Investigators are looking into the motive.

zh.headline: 上水醉漢涉用瓷磚襲擊途人被捕
zh.dek: 一名53歲男子涉嫌傷人被捕，警方指他周三深夜在上水以瓷磚襲擊一名48歲男子，傷者面嘴受傷送院。
body: 上水發生傷人案。警方表示，一名53歲男子涉嫌傷人被捕，案件交由大埔警區刑事調查隊跟進。
周三晚上約11時，警方接獲途人報案，指新成路與新祥街交界有人打架。初步調查顯示，姓陳的53歲男子以一塊瓷磚襲擊姓吳的48歲男子。陳男被捕，正被扣留調查。
吳男面部及嘴部受傷，清醒被送往北區醫院治理，陳男亦被送院檢查。警方指陳男身上有酒氣，與吳男並不相識，正調查施襲原因。
